memoryNotes.note: Chased phantom investors in Madrid over a fake mom joke.
Used Thursday's IEEE paper metadata to debunk viral funding claims.
Exposed the million-euro funding announcement as a mere cafeteria photo.
Mocked Cala's gullibility regarding the viral cafeteria prank.
Relied exclusively on public data and scrape logs to disprove zero numbers.
